repoDir.description: Main checkout of the project; worktrees are created from it. ~ is expanded.

worktreeRoot.description: Directory that holds one worktree per task; a worktree name is resolved against it.

sharedDir.description: Task folders live here: <sharedDir>/<task>/{BRIEF,analyst,prog,test,review}.md. Guard logs go here too.

guardCommand.description: Full guard run, executed with zsh in the worktree. Placeholders: {wt} worktree directory, {jobs} worker count from the slot budget, {limitFile} (optional) file the runner re-reads for an adaptive worker limit.

guardCommandLegacy.description: Guard command for worktrees whose runner has no adaptive limit (no {limitFile}). Used when guardAdaptiveProbe fails.

guardAdaptiveProbe.description: When set, guardCommand is used only if <wt>/<file> contains <contains>; otherwise guardCommandLegacy.

scan.description: Directories whose git-ignored contents are copied into a new worktree.

skip.description: Globs of ignored paths that are not copied.

link.description: Globs of ignored paths that are symlinked instead of cloned. Everything else is an APFS clone (cp -c), never a link.

medium.description: Medium slots (tsc, one bundler build without a browser).

heavy.description: Heavy slots (browser guards, full guard runs, image builds). One more is admitted only while free memory holds and swap does not grow.

total.description: Ceiling for medium + heavy slots together.

lockDir.description: Directory for slot lock files and the waiting queue.

legacyLock.description: Optional single lock file of an older setup; while held it counts as one heavy slot.

jobsAlone.description: Guard workers of all full runs together; a lone full run gets all of them.

jobsShared.description: Worker cap for a full run while another heavy slot is busy.

reportLanguage.description: Language of role reports (prompts stay in English).

protectedBranches.description: Branches nobody pushes to without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1.

protectedTagPattern.description: Regular expression for tag names that must not be pushed without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1 (e.g. release tags that deploy).

ownerStackReadOnly.description: Docker Compose project of the owner: roles may only read from it.

medianTaskIE.description: Median input-equivalent tokens of an accepted task; chain-cost flags tasks above twice this.

testerWritable.description: Regular expressions of paths the tester may change (guards and their fixtures).

roleNotes.description: Project-specific lines appended to one role's prompt.

threatModel.description: Path (relative to the worktree) of the threat model the security reviewer reads.

blockICloudCopies.description: pre-commit refuses files named like iCloud conflict copies ("name 2.ext").

preCommit.description: Extra shell commands run by pre-commit in the repository root; a non-zero exit refuses the commit.

minFreeDiskGB.description: Free disk (GB) the preconditions require on the volumes of the worktree and the task folder (default 10).

minSwapGB.description: Swap headroom (GB) the preconditions require: on macOS the free part of the swap files plus the free space of the VM volume, on Linux SwapFree (default 4: four slots of ~1 GB).

preconditions.description: Environment floors checked by the preconditions with scripts/env-check.js; below them the task stops before any agent instead of a tester going red for the environment.

branches.description: Branches this repository's HEAD may be pushed to without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1.

check.description: Shell command run in the repository root before the push (e.g. the test for secrets and personal paths); a non-zero exit refuses the push.

standingPush.description: Standing permission to push - only for the repository of process rules (the plugin itself), whose owner granted it; never in a product repository. Honoured only from the committed config of the repository that pushes (not the session's project, not an uncommitted edit), only for the checked-out HEAD with unmodified tracked files, never forced or deleting; tags are never covered.
